landingPage.title: Transit Map Editor

helpDialog.title: Transit Map Editor - User Guide
helpDialog.gettingStartedBody: The Transit Map Editor is a browser-based tool for creating schematic transit maps with octolinear (45° and 90°) routing.
helpDialog.selectToolDesc: Click a station to select it (blue ring). Hold Shift and click to multi-select. Drag selected stations to move them. Press Delete or Backspace to delete all selected. Double-click a station to rename it. Right-click a station for a context menu with rename, delete, label position, and label rotation options.
helpDialog.stationToolDesc: Click anywhere on the canvas to create a new station. Stations snap to the grid and to octolinear angles from nearby stations.
helpDialog.segmentToolDesc: Click a station to start a segment, then click another station to connect them. Segments snap to octolinear angles. Double-click a segment path to add a bend point; double-click an existing bend point to remove it. Drag bend points to adjust the route.
helpDialog.shapeToolDesc: Click on the canvas to place polygon vertices. Double-click to finalize the shape, or press Escape to cancel. Press Backspace or Delete to undo the last placed point. Click a finished shape to select it, then drag the white vertex handles to edit. Press Delete or Escape to deselect or remove a selected shape.
helpDialog.serviceIconsDesc: Tag stations with service icons (accessibility, ferry, rail, airport, toilet). Icons appear in parentheses after the station name.
helpDialog.creatingLinesBody: When using the Segment tool, select a line from the dropdown before creating segments. To create a new line:
helpDialog.creatingLineStep2: 2. Enter a name and optional short code (e.g. 'U1')
helpDialog.creatingLineStep3: 3. Choose a line style (solid, dashed, double) and transit mode (metro, rail, tram, bus, ferry)
helpDialog.creatingLineStep4: 4. Select a color from the palette or enter a custom hex code (e.g., #ff00ff)
helpDialog.deleteShortcut: Delete selected stations, segments, or shapes
helpDialog.escapeShortcut: Cancel shape drawing, deselect shape, or cancel rename dialog
helpDialog.removeShapePointShortcut: Remove the last placed shape point
helpDialog.doubleClickShortcut: Rename station, add bend point to segment, or finalize a shape
helpDialog.arrowKeysShortcut: Move the keyboard cursor (blue crosshair) on the canvas. If stations or a shape are selected, moves them instead
helpDialog.tabShortcut: Cycle to the next station (hold Shift for previous)
helpDialog.enterShortcut: With the keyboard cursor: create a station, connect a segment, add a shape point, or select the nearest station/shape
helpDialog.zoomInControlDesc: Click the Zoom In button or scroll up with the mouse wheel. Zoom centers on the cursor position.
helpDialog.zoomOutControlDesc: Click the Zoom Out button or scroll down with the mouse wheel. Zoom centers on the cursor position.
helpDialog.resetViewControlDesc: Click the Reset View button to return to the default zoom level and center the viewport.
helpDialog.panControlDesc: Hold Space and drag, or hold the middle mouse button and drag.
helpDialog.themeToggleControlDesc: Click the moon/sun icon in the toolbar to switch between light and dark mode. Your preference is saved across sessions.
helpDialog.exportBody: Use 'Export SVG' to save your map as a vector file, 'Export PNG' as a raster image, or 'Print' to send it directly to your printer. Interactive handles are hidden automatically in exports and print.
helpDialog.importExportJSONBody: Use 'Export JSON' to save your complete map data for backup or sharing. Use 'Import JSON' to load a previously exported map.
helpDialog.backgroundImageBody: Load a background image (e.g., a city map) to help with positioning. Toggle visibility with the 'Show/Hide BG' button.
helpDialog.autoSaveBody: The editor automatically saves your work to your browser's local storage. Your stations, segments, lines, and active tool are saved automatically and will be restored when you return to the editor.
helpDialog.autoSaveNote: Note: The undo/redo history and viewport position are not saved between sessions.
helpDialog.gridSizeBody: Adjust the grid size for more precise station placement. Range: 10-100.
helpDialog.lineWidthBody: Customize the thickness of lines on your map. Range: 1-20 pixels. Default: 10 pixels.
helpDialog.tip1: • Use the mouse wheel to zoom in and out; hold Space to pan
helpDialog.tip2: • Stations and bend points snap to octolinear angles (0°, 45°, 90°, etc.) for clean, professional-looking maps
helpDialog.tip3: • Hold Shift and click stations to select multiple at once for batch operations
helpDialog.tip4: • Double-click a segment path to insert a bend point for fine-grained routing control
helpDialog.tip5: • Select a line in the toolbar to dim everything else and trace its route easily
helpDialog.tip6: • Use the Shape tool with low opacity to add water, parks, or land backgrounds behind your transit network
helpDialog.tip7: • Right-click a station to quickly adjust its label position or rotation when names overlap
helpDialog.tip8: • Assign line codes (e.g. 'M1', 'A') so small coloured badges appear next to stations, like real transit maps
helpDialog.tip9: • SVG exports work with external editors like Gimp and Inkscape for further editing
helpDialog.tip10: • Use undo/redo frequently to experiment with different layouts
helpDialog.tip11: • Toggle between light and dark themes with the moon/sun icon in the toolbar
helpDialog.tip12: • Assign service icons to stations for richer map information
